newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Fatigued FTSE to attempt to reach 4,700.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Fatigued FTSE to attempt to reach 4,700.

text.p: The short-term uptrend in the FTSE 100 index is beginning to run out of fire power but it is not ready to make a swift reversal yet and before it does it is capable of making one move towards 4,700, technical analysts said on Friday.
Market action on Thursday revealed little appetite among investors to push the index too far from 4,670 -- which is now a pivotal area from which the market can easily roam within a 30 point range.
By 0716 GMT, at the pre-market open, the FTSE was indicated up 3.6 at 4,675.9.
